name: EWA Splatting
aliases: EWA Volume Splatting with Perspective Projection
definition: A rendering technique that treats each point as a Gaussian reconstruction kernel on the surface, projects it into screen space, and convolves it with a low-pass filter to produce a resampling filter actually rasterized. This implementation uses a simplified kernel: screen-aligned spherical impostors with isotropic linear falloff, rasterized as plain point sprites, trading anisotropic, correctly band-limited footprint for a formulation needing no per-point normals or radii.
summary: EWA Splatting renders 3D Gaussians as anisotropic elliptical disks to efficiently approximate volumetric integration without ray-marching.
